contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and FND-0099 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. The real tension is with the single sentence inside corroborated packet finding FND-0097 that attributes exactness of both pi_* and restriction-to-Gamma on 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 to finiteness of Gamma over the base. Independent check: (1) For a short exact sequence of coherent sheaves on a relative curve pi:C->B, the LES of higher direct images is 0->pi_*W_4->pi_*W->pi_*W_5->R^1 pi_* W_4->...; surjectivity of pi_*W->pi_*W_5 requires the connecting map into R^1 pi_* W_4 to vanish, and is guaranteed by R^1 pi_* W_4=0. Finiteness of Gamma->B is irrelevant to that LES. (2) What finiteness of Gamma does give: restriction of a locally free (hence locally split) SES to Gamma remains exact, and pushforward along finite Gamma->B is exact (finite morphisms are affine). (3) Primary degree from SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (Canning–Larson, arXiv:2208.02357v2): deg W_f|_C=4g+12-4f. For the filtered f=4 summand at g=6 one has deg W_4=20>2g-2=10, so on geometric fibres H^1(W_4)=0 by Serre duality (deg(omega W_4^{-1})<0); with flat proper pi and fibrewise vanishing, cohomology-and-base-change yields R^1 pi_* W_4=0. (4) coker(phi_4)=0: from 0->W_4(-Gamma)->W_4->W_4|Gamma->0 the restriction map on pi_* is surjective once R^1 pi_* W_4(-Gamma)=0; deg W_4(-Gamma)=20-6=14>10 supplies fibrewise H^1=0, and base-change plus Nakayama descend coker=0 to the sheaf. (5) With those two vanishings the snake lemma and Fit_0(coker phi)=Fit_0(coker phi_5) are correct for (6,6), so FND-0097’s filtered-CE conclusion survives; only its justification that ‘Gamma finite => pi_* exact’ is false. Downstream C66-GEO-Z filtered-CE arguments must cite the degree vanishings explicitly and recheck them for any (g,n) with deg W_4<=2g-2. Distinct from FND-0096 (universal Pic^0 Fitting) and from FND-0097’s main load-bearing point (replace global splitting by relative HN filtration). Merge target: none. Promote candidate obstruction to corroborated on this independent primary/standard-cohomology verification.
